source.text: וַיָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּהַר֙ הַמּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְדָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יהוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּמְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And began Solomon to build [the] house of Yahweh in Jerusalem on [the] mount of the Moriah, where he appeared to David his father, which he prepared in [the] place of David, on [the] threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

en.L: And Solomon began to build the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had appeared to David his father, which he had prepared at the place of David, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
en.B: In Jerusalem, on Mount Moriah, Solomon began building the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It was there that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had appeared to his father David, at the site David had prepared, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
en.R: Solomon began to build the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah. That was where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had appeared to his father David. It was the place David had made ready, on the threshing floor that had belonged to Ornan the Jebusite. A threshing floor was a flat, open place where grain was beaten out.

es.L: Y comenzó Salomón a edificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, en el monte Moria, donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se había aparecido a David su padre, la que él había preparado en el lugar de David, en la era de Ornán el jebuseo.
es.B: En Jerusalén, en el monte Moria, Salomón comenzó a edificar la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí era donde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le había aparecido a su padre David, en el lugar que David había preparado, en la era de Ornán el jebuseo.
es.R: Salomón comenzó a construir el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, en el monte Moria. Allí era donde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se le había aparecido a su padre David. Era el lugar que David había preparado, en la era que había sido de Ornán el jebuseo. Una era es un lugar plano y abierto donde se trilla el grano.

fr.L: Et Salomon commença à bâtir la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, sur le mont Moria, où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était apparu à David son père, qu’il avait préparé à l’endroit de David, sur l’aire d’Ornân le Jébusien.
fr.B: À Jérusalem, sur le mont Moria, Salomon commença à bâtir la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’est là que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était apparu à son père David, à l’endroit que David avait préparé, sur l’aire d’Ornân le Jébusien.
fr.R: Salomon a commencé à construire le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, sur le mont Moria. C’est là que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était apparu à son père David. C’était l’endroit que David avait préparé, sur l’aire qui avait appartenu à Ornân le Jébusien. Une aire était un terrain plat et dégagé où l’on battait le grain.

sw.L: Sulemani akaanza kujenga nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu juu ya mlima Moria, mahali alipomtokea Daudi baba yake, ambapo alipatayarisha mahali pa Daudi, katika uwanja wa kupuria wa Ornani Myebusi.
sw.B: Huko Yerusalemu, juu ya mlima Moria, Sulemani alianza kujenga nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hapo ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomtokea baba yake Daudi, mahali alipopatayarisha Daudi, katika uwanja wa kupuria wa Ornani Myebusi.
sw.R: Sulemani alianza kujenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu juu ya mlima Moria. Hapo ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipomtokea baba yake Daudi. Palikuwa mahali ambapo Daudi alikuwa amepatayarisha, katika uwanja wa kupuria uliokuwa mali ya Ornani Myebusi. Uwanja wa kupuria ulikuwa mahali pa wazi palipo sawa, ambapo nafaka ilipigwa ili kutoa punje.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn bắt đầu xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, trên núi Mô-ri-a, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra với Đa-vít cha vua, [nơi] mà Đa-vít đã chuẩn bị, tại chỗ của Đa-vít, trên sân đập lúa của Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.B: Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, trên núi Mô-ri-a, Sa-lô-môn khởi công xây nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chính tại đó {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hiện ra với Đa-vít cha vua, ở nơi Đa-vít đã chuẩn bị, trên sân đập lúa của Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn bắt đầu xây đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, trên núi Mô-ri-a. Đó là nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hiện ra với Đa-vít cha vua. Đó cũng là nơi Đa-vít đã chuẩn bị sẵn, trên sân đập lúa trước kia thuộc về Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít. Sân đập lúa là một khoảng đất bằng phẳng, trống trải, nơi người ta đập lúa cho hạt rơi ra.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 예루살렘 모리아 산에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 짓기 시작했다. 그곳은 그분께서 그의 아버지 다윗에게 나타나신 곳이며, 그가 다윗의 장소, 곧 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당에 준비한 곳이었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 예루살렘 모리아 산에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 짓기 시작했다. 그곳은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 아버지 다윗에게 나타나신 곳으로, 다윗이 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당에 마련해 둔 자리였다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 예루살렘 모리아 산에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 짓기 시작했다. 그곳은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 아버지 다윗에게 나타나신 곳이었다. 그곳은 다윗이 미리 마련해 둔 자리로, 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당이었던 곳이었다. 타작마당은 곡식을 떠는 평평하고 넓은 곳이다.

decisions.choice: Mount Moriah: the temple hill, linked with the place where Abraham was sent to offer Isaac
decisions.reason: The name Moriah is found elsewhere only in Genesis 22:2, where God sent Abraham to "the land of Moriah" to offer Isaac on one of its mountains, and where God provided a ram in Isaac's place (Genesis 22:13-14). By calling the temple hill Mount Moriah, the writer ties the place of Israel's sacrifices to that mountain. Genesis itself speaks of a land with several mountains and does not name Jerusalem; the link is made here.

decisions.choice: the threshing floor of Ornan: the place of 1 Chronicles 21
decisions.reason: There the angel of Yahweh stood when the plague was stopped, David bought the threshing floor, built an altar, and Yahweh answered him with fire from heaven (1 Chronicles 21:15-26). David then said, "This is the house of Yahweh God" (1 Chronicles 22:1). 2 Samuel 24:16-25 tells the same story and spells the owner's name Araunah. 1 Kings 6:1, which this verse retells, does not name the site.

decisions.choice: where he had appeared: Yahweh appeared to David
alternatives: which had been shown to David
decisions.reason: The verb means "appeared" or "let himself be seen", and no subject is named. The one who appeared is Yahweh, whose answer came at this place (1 Chronicles 21:26; the same verb is used of God appearing to Solomon in 7:12). It could also be read "which had been shown to David", meaning the place itself.

decisions.choice: which he had prepared at the place of David: the place that David had prepared
alternatives: which he had prepared, at David's place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word order is awkward: "which he prepared, in the place of David". The early Greek translation reads "in the place that David prepared", which is likely the sense: David chose and bought the site and made ready the materials for the temple (1 Chronicles 21:25-22:5). Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: where the LORD had appeared
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the LORD as the one who appeared (m3); Literal keeps the bare verb with a pronoun.

decisions.choice: that had belonged to ...; A threshing floor was a flat, open place where grain was beaten out.
decisions.reason: David had bought the threshing floor from Ornan (1 Chronicles 21:25), so Readable says it had belonged to him, and explains the threshing floor as 2 Samuel 24:16 does. Balanced and Readable say "the house of the LORD" and "the temple of the LORD" as 1 Kings 6:1 does.

decisions.choice: "el monte Moria"; "Ornán el jebuseo"
decisions.reason: Moria takes the form of the Spanish Genesis 22:2, which the meaning decision links to this hill; Ornán follows the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: "donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se había aparecido" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names no subject (meaning decision); the English Literal writes "He" for Yahweh, and Spanish adds the pronoun with its span to show it, while Balanced and Readable name Yahweh.

decisions.choice: "le mont Moria"; "Ornân le Jébusien"
decisions.reason: "Moria" is the form of the French Pentateuch (Genesis 22:2), which Chronicles recalls (m1); "Ornân" is the terms note's form for Chronicles.

decisions.choice: mlima Moria; Ornani Myebusi
decisions.reason: "Moria" is the form of the Swahili Genesis 22:2, so the two passages are linked as the Hebrew links them (m1); Ornan is "Ornani", as the terms note.

decisions.choice: "núi Mô-ri-a"; "Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít"
decisions.reason: The names as the terms notes give them (Ornan is the Araunah of 2 Samuel 24).

decisions.choice: "nhà của CHÚA" (L, B); "đền thờ của CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the house of the LORD in these books, as the terms note; with "house" alone Balanced says "đền thờ" as in 1 Kings 6.

decisions.choice: "나타나신" with the honorific for God; "여부스 사람 오르난", "타작마당"
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; the one who appeared is the LORD (m3), so Korean gives it the honorific at every level and Balanced and Readable name him, as the English does. Ornan as in the terms note.

source.text: וַ֠יָּחֶל לִבְנ֞וֹת בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ בַּשֵּׁנִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he began to build in the month the second, on the second, in [the] year four of his reign.

en.L: And he began to build in the second month, on the second [day], in the fourth year of his reign.
en.B: He began to build in the fourth year of his reign, on the second day of the second month.
en.R: He started building in the fourth year that he was king, on the second day of the second month of the year, in spring.

es.L: Y comenzó a edificar en el mes segundo, el [día] segundo, en el año cuarto de su reinado.
es.B: Comenzó a edificar en el cuarto año de su reinado, el segundo día del segundo mes.
es.R: Empezó a construir en el cuarto año de su reinado, el segundo día del segundo mes del año, en primavera.

fr.L: Et il commença à bâtir au deuxième mois, le deux, en la quatrième année de son règne.
fr.B: Il commença à bâtir la quatrième année de son règne, le deuxième jour du deuxième mois.
fr.R: Il a commencé la construction la quatrième année de son règne, le deuxième jour du deuxième mois de l’année, au printemps.

sw.L: Akaanza kujenga katika mwezi wa pili, [siku ya] pili, katika mwaka wa nne wa kutawala kwake.
sw.B: Alianza kujenga katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wake, siku ya pili ya mwezi wa pili.
sw.R: Alianza kujenga katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wake, siku ya pili ya mwezi wa pili wa mwaka, wakati wa majira ya kuchipua.

vi.L: Vua bắt đầu xây vào tháng thứ hai, ngày thứ hai, năm thứ tư triều đại vua.
vi.B: Vua khởi công xây vào ngày mồng hai tháng thứ hai, năm thứ tư triều đại vua.
vi.R: Vua bắt đầu xây vào năm thứ tư vua cai trị, ngày mồng hai tháng thứ hai trong năm, vào mùa xuân.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 통치 제4년 둘째 달 둘째 [날]에 짓기 시작했다.
ko.B: 그는 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해 둘째 달 2일에 짓기 시작했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해의 둘째 달 2일, 봄에 성전을 짓기 시작했다.

decisions.choice: on the second: the second day of the month
alternatives: in the second month (without a day)
decisions.reason: The words "on the second" stand after "in the second month" with no word for "day", and some ancient translations do not have them. They may be a copying repeat of the word before them. Kept as the Hebrew text has them, they give the day of the month.

decisions.choice: in the fourth year of his reign: as 1 Kings 6:1
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:1 gives the same year and month, names the month Ziv, and dates the building from the exodus, the 480th year after Israel came out of Egypt. Chronicles gives only the year of Solomon's reign.

decisions.choice: on the second day of the second month
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the date in the usual English order and supply "day".

decisions.choice: of the year, in spring
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:1, Readable adds the season so that the month means something to the reader.

decisions.choice: "제4년" (L), "4년째 되는 해" (B, R); Korean puts the year before the month and day
alternatives: 둘째 달 둘째 날, 그의 통치 제4년에
decisions.reason: Korean dates run from the year to the day; regnal years in figures as in the terms note.

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֖וֹת אֶת־בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּמִּדָּ֤ה הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים וְרֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] founding of Solomon to build the house of the God: the length, cubits by the measure the former, [was] cubits sixty, and [the] breadth cubits twenty.

en.L: And these [are] the foundation [measures] of Solomon for building the house of God: the length in cubits by the former measure [was] 60 cubits, and the breadth 20 cubits.
en.B: These are the measurements Solomon laid down for building the house of God: measured by the old standard, the length was {{units:about 90 feet|60 cubits}} and the width {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}.
en.R: Here are the measurements Solomon used for the base of God's temple. Measured by the old standard, it was {{units:about 90 feet|60 cubits}} long and {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} wide.

es.L: Y estos [son] los cimientos de Salomón para edificar la casa de Dios: la longitud en codos según la medida antigua, sesenta codos, y la anchura veinte codos.
es.B: Estas son las medidas que Salomón fijó para edificar la casa de Dios: según la medida antigua, la longitud era de {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}} y la anchura de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}.
es.R: Estas son las medidas que Salomón usó para la base del templo de Dios. Según la medida antigua, tenía {{units:unos 27 metros|sesenta codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho.

fr.L: Et voici les fondations de Salomon pour bâtir la maison de Dieu : la longueur en coudées, selon l’ancienne mesure, [était] de soixante coudées, et la largeur de vingt coudées.
fr.B: Voici les dimensions que Salomon fixa pour bâtir la maison de Dieu : mesurée selon l’ancienne coudée, la longueur était de {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} et la largeur de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}.
fr.R: Voici les mesures que Salomon a utilisées pour la base du temple de Dieu. Mesuré selon l’ancienne coudée, il avait {{units:environ 27 mètres|soixante coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large.

sw.L: Na hivi [ndivyo] vipimo vya msingi vya Sulemani vya kuijenga nyumba ya Mungu: urefu kwa dhiraa za kipimo cha zamani [ulikuwa] dhiraa sitini, na upana dhiraa ishirini.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo vipimo alivyoweka Sulemani kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu: kwa kipimo cha zamani, urefu ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}} na upana {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo vipimo ambavyo Sulemani alitumia kwa msingi wa hekalu la Mungu. Kwa kipimo cha zamani, urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 27|dhiraa sitini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}.

vi.L: Đây [là] nền [móng] của Sa-lô-môn để xây nhà của Đức Chúa Trời: chiều dài tính bằng cu-đê theo thước đo cũ [là] 60 cu-đê, và chiều rộng 20 cu-đê.
vi.B: Đây là kích thước Sa-lô-môn đã định để xây nhà của Đức Chúa Trời: theo thước đo cũ, chiều dài {{units:27 m|60 cu-đê}} và chiều rộng {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Đây là kích thước Sa-lô-môn dùng cho nền đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời. Theo thước đo cũ, đền thờ dài {{units:27 m|60 cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이것은 솔로몬이 하나님의 집을 짓기 위해 놓은 기초[의 치수]이다. 길이는 옛 자로 60규빗, 너비는 20규빗이었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 하나님의 집을 짓기 위해 정한 치수는 이러했다. 옛 자로 재어 길이가 {{units:27미터쯤|60규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 하나님의 성전 바닥을 놓을 때 쓴 치수는 이러했다. 옛날 자로 재어 길이가 {{units:27미터쯤|60규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: the founding: the ground plan Solomon laid down
decisions.reason: The word is a rare form of the verb "to lay a foundation". Here it introduces the measurements of the base of the building, the plan on which it was founded.

decisions.choice: cubits by the former measure: the older, longer cubit
decisions.reason: A cubit was the length from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger, about 18 inches. There was also a longer cubit, "a cubit and a handbreadth" (Ezekiel 40:5), about 20 1/2 inches. The writer notes that the temple was measured by the older standard of Solomon's day, most likely this longer cubit. The modern measures here reckon 18 inches, as in 1 Kings 6:2, so the building may have been somewhat larger.

decisions.choice: sixty by twenty cubits: as 1 Kings 6:2
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:2 gives the same length and width and adds a height of 30 cubits, which Chronicles does not give.

decisions.choice: modern measures with the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:2, Balanced and Readable give the size in feet, reckoning a cubit at about 18 inches; the reader's Measures control shows the cubits. Literal keeps the cubits throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: the house of God (Balanced); God's temple (Readable); temple for "the house" alone
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6, Literal keeps "house" throughout. Balanced keeps "house" in the full phrases "the house of God" and "the house of the LORD" and says "temple" where "the house" names the building; Readable says "temple" throughout.

decisions.choice: "codos" (L); metres with the cubits as the alternative (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cubit is counted at 45 cm, as the Kings terms note sets and the Spanish of 1 Kings 6 does; the meaning decision notes the older, longer cubit, which the round figures leave aside.

decisions.choice: metric measures, with the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in French Kings (1 Kings 6:2), French gives metres by default, counting a cubit at 45 cm as the terms note sets out, with the cubits as the alternative; the English converts to feet.

decisions.choice: karibu mita 27; karibu mita 9 (metric default), with the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in the Swahili 1 Kings 6:2: a cubit is reckoned at 45 cm and the metric figure is the default, with "dhiraa" as the alternative; Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: metres by default (cubit 45 cm), "cu-đê" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:2; the English converts to feet. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: Metres by default (cubit 45 cm, "27미터쯤"), "60규빗" as the alternative; numbers in figures
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:2 and the terms note; Literal keeps the cubits.

source.text: וְהָאוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־פְּנֵ֨י הָאֹ֜רֶךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהַגֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְצַפֵּ֥הוּ מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the porch which [was] on [the] face, the length on [the] face of [the] breadth of the house [was] cubits twenty, and the height one hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it within [with] gold pure.

en.L: And the porch that [was] in front: its length, along the breadth of the house, [was] 20 cubits, and the height 120; and he overlaid it inside [with] pure gold.
en.B: The porch in front of the temple was {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} long, matching the width of the temple, and {{units:about 180 feet|120 cubits}} high. He overlaid its inside with pure gold.
en.R: In front of the temple there was a porch. It ran {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} across the whole front of the temple, and it was {{units:about 180 feet|120 cubits}} high. Solomon covered the inside of it with pure gold.

es.L: Y el pórtico que [estaba] al frente: su longitud, a lo ancho de la casa, [era] de veinte codos, y la altura de ciento veinte; y lo revistió por dentro [de] oro puro.
es.B: El pórtico que estaba al frente del templo tenía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo, igual que el ancho del templo, y {{units:unos 54 metros|ciento veinte codos}} de alto. Lo revistió por dentro de oro puro.
es.R: Delante del templo había un pórtico. Medía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} a lo largo de todo el frente del templo, y tenía {{units:unos 54 metros|ciento veinte codos}} de alto. Salomón lo cubrió por dentro con oro puro.

fr.L: Et le vestibule qui [était] sur le devant : sa longueur, sur la largeur de la maison, [était] de vingt coudées, et la hauteur de cent vingt ; et il le recouvrit à l’intérieur d’or pur.
fr.B: Le vestibule, devant le temple, avait {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long, autant que la largeur du temple, et {{units:environ 54 mètres|cent vingt coudées}} de haut. Il en recouvrit l’intérieur d’or pur.
fr.R: Devant le temple, il y avait un vestibule. Il s’étendait sur {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}, sur toute la largeur de la façade du temple, et il avait {{units:environ 54 mètres|cent vingt coudées}} de haut. Salomon en a couvert l’intérieur d’or pur.

sw.L: Na baraza lililokuwa mbele: urefu wake, kufuata upana wa nyumba, [ulikuwa] dhiraa ishirini, na kimo 120; akalifunika ndani [kwa] dhahabu safi.
sw.B: Baraza lililokuwa mbele ya hekalu lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, sawa na upana wa hekalu, na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 54|dhiraa 120}}. Akalifunika ndani kwa dhahabu safi.
sw.R: Mbele ya hekalu kulikuwa na baraza. Lilienea {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} upande wote wa mbele wa hekalu, na kimo chake kilikuwa {{units:karibu mita 54|dhiraa 120}}. Sulemani alilifunika ndani kwa dhahabu safi.

vi.L: Tiền sảnh ở phía trước: chiều dài theo chiều rộng của nhà [là] 20 cu-đê, và chiều cao 120; vua bọc bên trong [bằng] vàng ròng.
vi.B: Tiền sảnh phía trước đền thờ dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, bằng chiều rộng đền thờ, và cao {{units:54 m|120 cu-đê}}. Vua bọc bên trong tiền sảnh bằng vàng ròng.
vi.R: Phía trước đền thờ có một tiền sảnh. Tiền sảnh dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, chạy suốt mặt tiền đền thờ, và cao {{units:54 m|120 cu-đê}}. Sa-lô-môn bọc bên trong tiền sảnh bằng vàng ròng.

ko.L: 그리고 앞에 있는 현관은 그 길이가 집의 너비를 따라 20규빗이었고, 높이는 120이었다. 그리고 그가 그 안을 순금으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 성전 앞에 있는 현관은 길이가 성전의 너비와 같은 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었고, 높이는 {{units:54미터쯤|120규빗}}이었다. 그는 그 안을 순금으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 성전 앞에는 현관이 있었다. 현관은 성전 앞면 전체에 걸쳐 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었고, 높이는 {{units:54미터쯤|120규빗}}이었다. 솔로몬은 그 안을 순금으로 덮었다.

decisions.choice: one hundred and twenty: the height of the porch as the Hebrew text gives it
decisions.reason: A porch 120 cubits high would rise four times above the 30-cubit house (1 Kings 6:2), and 1 Kings 6:3 gives the porch no height at all. Some copies of the early Greek translation and the Syriac translation read "twenty cubits", and the Hebrew words for "hundred" and "cubits" look alike, so "hundred" may have come from a misread "cubits". The Hebrew number is kept; if it is right, the porch was a tall tower at the entrance.

decisions.choice: the porch in front; its length along the breadth of the house
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:3, the porch is the entrance hall at the front of the temple. Its length of 20 cubits ran across the front, the same as the width of the house (verse 3). The Hebrew of this half of the verse is very compressed, and the porch's depth (10 cubits in 1 Kings 6:3) is not given.

decisions.choice: overlaid ... with pure gold
decisions.reason: The verb means to overlay or plate, as with the gold of the ark (Exodus 25:11) and of the inner room (1 Kings 6:20). "Pure" gold is refined gold.

decisions.choice: porch (all levels); overlaid (Literal, Balanced), covered (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:3 and 6:20.

decisions.choice: "el pórtico"; "revistió" (L, B), "cubrió" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 6, through the temple chapters: "revestir" for overlaying with gold at Literal and Balanced, the plain "cubrir" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "현관" for the porch; "입혔다" (L, B), "덮었다" (R) for overlaying
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6-7.

source.text: וְאֵ֣ת׀הַבַּ֣יִת הַגָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיְחַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְשַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the house the great he covered [with] wood of cypresses, and he overlaid it [with] gold fine, and he put up on it palm trees and chains.

en.L: And the great house he covered [with] cypress wood, and he overlaid it [with] fine gold, and he set on it palm trees and chains.
en.B: He paneled the main hall with cypress wood and overlaid it with fine gold, and he decorated it with palm trees and chains.
en.R: He lined the walls of the main room with cypress wood and covered it with fine gold. Then he decorated it with designs of palm trees and chains.

es.L: Y la casa grande la cubrió [de] madera de ciprés, y la revistió [de] oro fino, e hizo poner sobre ella palmeras y cadenas.
es.B: Recubrió la sala principal con madera de ciprés, la revistió de oro fino y la adornó con palmeras y cadenas.
es.R: Cubrió con madera de ciprés las paredes de la sala principal y la cubrió con oro fino. Luego la adornó con figuras de palmeras y cadenas.

fr.L: Et la grande maison, il la couvrit de bois de cyprès, et il la recouvrit d’or fin, et il y mit des palmes et des chaînettes.
fr.B: Il lambrissa la grande salle de bois de cyprès et la recouvrit d’or fin, et il la décora de palmes et de chaînettes.
fr.R: Il a couvert les murs de la salle principale de bois de cyprès, puis il les a recouverts d’or fin. Ensuite, il les a décorés de motifs de palmiers et de chaînettes.

sw.L: Na nyumba kubwa akaifunika [kwa] mbao za misunobari, akaifunika [kwa] dhahabu nzuri, akaweka juu yake mitende na minyororo.
sw.B: Alizipiga kuta za ukumbi mkuu mbao za misunobari, akaufunika kwa dhahabu nzuri, akaupamba kwa michoro ya mitende na minyororo.
sw.R: Alizifunika kuta za chumba kikuu kwa mbao za misunobari, kisha akazifunika kwa dhahabu nzuri. Akazipamba kwa michoro ya mitende na minyororo.

vi.L: Còn nhà lớn thì vua bọc [bằng] gỗ bách, rồi bọc nó [bằng] vàng tốt, và đặt lên đó [hình] cây chà là và dây xích.
vi.B: Vua ốp chính điện bằng gỗ bách và bọc vàng tốt, rồi trang trí bằng hình cây chà là và dây xích.
vi.R: Vua ốp các bức tường của gian chính bằng gỗ bách rồi bọc vàng tốt. Sau đó vua trang trí bằng hình cây chà là và dây xích.

ko.L: 그리고 큰 집은 그가 잣나무로 덮고, 그것을 좋은 금으로 입히고, 그 위에 종려나무와 사슬을 새겨 올렸다.
ko.B: 그는 본당 벽을 잣나무 널판으로 두르고 좋은 금으로 입힌 다음, 종려나무와 사슬 모양으로 꾸몄다.
ko.R: 그는 큰 방의 벽을 잣나무 널빤지로 덮고, 그 위를 좋은 금으로 덮었다. 그리고 종려나무와 사슬 무늬로 꾸몄다.

decisions.choice: the great house: the main hall
decisions.reason: "The great house" is the large front room of the temple, 40 cubits long, in front of the most holy place (1 Kings 6:17), called "the hall" in 1 Kings 6:3.

decisions.choice: covered with cypress wood: 1 Kings 6:15 names cedar for the walls
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:15 says the walls were lined with cedar boards and the floor with cypress. Chronicles speaks only of cypress for the main hall. Cypress here is a tall evergreen tree from Lebanon (2:7), whose exact kind is not certain.

decisions.choice: set on it palm trees and chains: decorations in relief
decisions.reason: The verb means "to make go up", here to set designs on the gold-covered walls. Palm trees were carved on the walls (1 Kings 6:29); the chains may be a chain-like pattern of garlands, as on the pillars (verse 16; 1 Kings 6:21). "Fine" gold is literally "good" gold.

decisions.choice: covered (Literal), paneled (Balanced), lined the walls (Readable); the great house (Literal), the main hall (Balanced), the main room (Readable)
decisions.reason: With wood, the verb for covering means paneling, as in 1 Kings 6:15. Balanced and Readable name the room as 1 Kings 6:3 does.

decisions.choice: "la casa grande" (L); "la sala principal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the great house is the main hall, called "la sala principal" at Balanced and Readable, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 6:3.

decisions.choice: "la grande maison" (L), "la grande salle" (B), "la salle principale" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "house"; Balanced and Readable name the room as French Kings does (1 Kings 6:3).

decisions.choice: nyumba kubwa (Literal); ukumbi mkuu (Balanced); chumba kikuu (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Swahili 1 Kings 6-7 names the main hall: Literal keeps "the great house", Balanced and Readable name the room (m1).

decisions.choice: "nhà lớn" (L); "chính điện" (B); "gian chính" (R); "bọc" (L), "ốp" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The names of the main hall kept from 1 Kings 6 (m1); with wood, the verb of covering means paneling, as 1 Kings 6:15.
"The great house" is the main hall (m1); Balanced and Readable use the words of 1 Kings 6:3.

source.text: וַיְצַ֧ף אֶת־הַבַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְהַזָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he overlaid the house [with] stone precious for beauty; and the gold [was] gold of Parvaim.

en.L: And he overlaid the house [with] precious stone for beauty; and the gold [was] gold of Parvaim.
en.B: He adorned the temple with precious stones to make it beautiful, and the gold he used was gold from Parvaim.
en.R: He decorated the temple with precious stones to make it beautiful. The gold he used came from Parvaim.

es.L: Y revistió la casa [de] piedra preciosa para hermosura; y el oro [era] oro de Parvaim.
es.B: Adornó el templo con piedras preciosas para embellecerlo, y el oro que usó era oro de Parvaim.
es.R: Adornó el templo con piedras preciosas para que se viera hermoso. El oro que usó venía de Parvaim.

fr.L: Et il recouvrit la maison de pierres précieuses pour la beauté ; et l’or [était] de l’or de Parvaïm.
fr.B: Il orna le temple de pierres précieuses pour l’embellir, et l’or qu’il employa était de l’or de Parvaïm.
fr.R: Il a décoré le temple de pierres précieuses pour le rendre beau. L’or qu’il a utilisé venait de Parvaïm.

sw.L: Akaifunika nyumba [kwa] mawe ya thamani kwa uzuri; na dhahabu [ilikuwa] dhahabu ya Parvaimu.
sw.B: Akalipamba hekalu kwa vito vya thamani ili kulipa uzuri, na dhahabu aliyotumia ilikuwa dhahabu ya Parvaimu.
sw.R: Akalipamba hekalu kwa vito vya thamani ili kulifanya zuri. Dhahabu aliyotumia ilitoka Parvaimu.

vi.L: Vua bọc nhà [bằng] đá quý cho đẹp; còn vàng [là] vàng Phạt-va-im.
vi.B: Vua trang hoàng đền thờ bằng đá quý cho thêm đẹp, và vàng vua dùng là vàng Phạt-va-im.
vi.R: Vua trang trí đền thờ bằng đá quý cho đẹp. Vàng vua dùng được lấy từ Phạt-va-im.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 집을 아름답게 하려고 보석으로 입혔다. 그리고 그 금은 바르와임의 금이었다.
ko.B: 그는 성전을 보석으로 꾸며 아름답게 했다. 그가 쓴 금은 바르와임에서 난 금이었다.
ko.R: 그는 성전을 값진 보석으로 꾸며 아름답게 했다. 그가 쓴 금은 바르와임에서 가져온 것이었다.

decisions.choice: overlaid with precious stone: set with precious stones
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for overlaying with gold; with stones it means adorning the house by setting them in it. "Stone" stands for stones of every kind, which David had gathered for the temple (1 Chronicles 29:2). 1 Kings does not mention them.

decisions.choice: Parvaim: a place known for its gold, whose location is unknown
decisions.reason: The name is found only here. It is probably a land from which fine gold came, perhaps in Arabia, but it cannot be located, and it may instead name a kind or quality of gold.

decisions.choice: overlaid (Literal), adorned (Balanced), decorated (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb used for gold; Balanced and Readable use a verb that fits stones.

source.text: וַיְחַ֨ף אֶת־הַבַּ֜יִת הַקֹּר֧וֹת הַסִּפִּ֛ים וְקִֽירוֹתָ֥יו וְדַלְתוֹתָ֖יו זָהָ֑ב וּפִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל־הַקִּירֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, and its walls and its doors, [with] gold; and he engraved cherubim on the walls.

en.L: And he overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds and its walls and its doors, [with] gold; and he engraved cherubim on the walls.
en.B: He overlaid the temple with gold, its beams, its thresholds, its walls and its doors, and he carved cherubim on the walls.
en.R: He covered the temple with gold: the beams, the doorsteps, the walls and the doors. He carved cherubim on the walls. Cherubim are winged heavenly creatures.

es.L: Y revistió la casa, las vigas, los umbrales y sus muros y sus puertas, [de] oro; y talló querubines en los muros.
es.B: Revistió de oro el templo: sus vigas, sus umbrales, sus muros y sus puertas; y talló querubines en los muros.
es.R: Cubrió el templo con oro: las vigas, los umbrales, las paredes y las puertas. En las paredes talló querubines. Los querubines son seres celestiales con alas.

fr.L: Et il recouvrit d’or la maison, les poutres, les seuils, et ses murs, et ses portes ; et il grava des chérubins sur les murs.
fr.B: Il recouvrit d’or le temple, ses poutres, ses seuils, ses murs et ses portes, et il sculpta des chérubins sur les murs.
fr.R: Il a couvert d’or le temple : les poutres, les seuils, les murs et les portes. Il a sculpté des chérubins sur les murs. Les chérubins sont des êtres célestes qui ont des ailes.

sw.L: Akaifunika nyumba, boriti, vizingiti, na kuta zake na milango yake, [kwa] dhahabu; akachora makerubi juu ya kuta.
sw.B: Akalifunika hekalu kwa dhahabu: boriti zake, vizingiti vyake, kuta zake na milango yake; akachonga makerubi juu ya kuta.
sw.R: Alilifunika hekalu kwa dhahabu: boriti, vizingiti, kuta na milango. Akachonga makerubi juu ya kuta. Makerubi ni viumbe wa mbinguni wenye mabawa.

vi.L: Vua bọc nhà, các xà, các ngưỡng cửa, các tường và các cửa của nó [bằng] vàng; và vua chạm các chê-ru-bim trên các tường.
vi.B: Vua bọc vàng cả đền thờ, các xà, các ngưỡng cửa, các tường và các cửa, và chạm hình các chê-ru-bim trên tường.
vi.R: Vua bọc vàng cả đền thờ: các xà, các ngưỡng cửa, các bức tường và các cửa. Vua chạm hình các chê-ru-bim trên tường. Chê-ru-bim là những sinh vật thiên thượng có cánh.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 집, 곧 들보와 문지방과 그 벽과 그 문을 금으로 입혔다. 그리고 벽에 그룹들을 새겼다.
ko.B: 그는 성전의 들보와 문지방과 벽과 문을 모두 금으로 입히고, 벽에는 그룹들을 새겼다.
ko.R: 그는 성전을 금으로 덮었다. 들보와 문턱과 벽과 문을 모두 덮었다. 그리고 벽에 그룹들을 새겼다. 그룹은 날개가 달린 하늘의 존재이다.

decisions.choice: the house, the beams, the thresholds ...: the parts of the house that were overlaid
decisions.reason: The list after "the house" says which parts of it were covered with gold.

decisions.choice: cherubim: winged heavenly beings who guard God's presence
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:23. Cherubim guarded the way to the tree of life (Genesis 3:24) and stood over the ark (Exodus 25:18-22). 1 Kings 6:29 adds that palm trees and open flowers were carved with them.

decisions.choice: Cherubim are winged heavenly creatures.
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:23, Readable explains the word the first time it appears in the chapter.

decisions.choice: "Los querubines son seres celestiales con alas"
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 6:23, Readable says what cherubim are.

decisions.choice: "그룹은 날개가 달린 하늘의 존재이다."
decisions.reason: Readable explains cherubim once in this block, as the English Readable does and as 1 Kings 6:23.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת־בֵּֽית־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים אָרְכּ֞וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְרָחְבּ֖וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְחַפֵּ֨הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְכִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made [the] house of [the] holy of the holies: its length on [the] face of [the] breadth of the house [was] cubits twenty, and its breadth cubits twenty; and he overlaid it [with] gold fine, to talents six hundred.

en.L: And he made the house of the holy of holies: its length, along the breadth of the house, [was] 20 cubits, and its breadth 20 cubits; and he overlaid it [with] fine gold, amounting to 600 talents.
en.B: He made the most holy place. Its length, matching the width of the temple, was {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}, and its width was {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}. He overlaid it with fine gold weighing {{units:about 45,000 pounds|600 talents}}.
en.R: He made the most holy place. It was {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} long, the same as the width of the temple, and {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} wide. He covered it with {{units:about 45,000 pounds|600 talents}} of fine gold.

es.L: E hizo la casa del santo de los santos: su longitud, a lo ancho de la casa, [era] de veinte codos, y su anchura de veinte codos; y la revistió [de] oro fino, de seiscientos talentos.
es.B: Hizo el lugar santísimo. Su longitud, igual al ancho del templo, era de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}, y su anchura de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}. Lo revistió de oro fino, que pesaba {{units:unos 20 400 kilos|seiscientos talentos}}.
es.R: Hizo el lugar santísimo. Medía {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo, igual que el ancho del templo, y {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de ancho. Lo cubrió con {{units:unos 20 400 kilos|seiscientos talentos}} de oro fino.

fr.L: Et il fit la maison du saint des saints : sa longueur, sur la largeur de la maison, [était] de vingt coudées, et sa largeur de vingt coudées ; et il la recouvrit d’or fin, pour six cents talents.
fr.B: Il fit le lieu très saint. Sa longueur, égale à la largeur du temple, était de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}, et sa largeur de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}. Il le recouvrit d’or fin pesant {{units:environ 20 tonnes|six cents talents}}.
fr.R: Il a fait le lieu très saint. Il avait {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long, autant que la largeur du temple, et {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de large. Il l’a couvert de {{units:environ 20 tonnes|six cents talents}} d’or fin.

sw.L: Akaifanya nyumba ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu: urefu wake, kufuata upana wa nyumba, [ulikuwa] dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake dhiraa ishirini; akaifunika [kwa] dhahabu nzuri, ya talanta 600.
sw.B: Akafanya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu. Urefu wake, sawa na upana wa hekalu, ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Akapafunika kwa dhahabu nzuri yenye uzito wa {{units:karibu kilo 20,400|talanta 600}}.
sw.R: Akafanya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu. Palikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, sawa na upana wa hekalu, na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Akapafunika kwa dhahabu nzuri ya {{units:karibu kilo 20,400|talanta 600}}.

vi.L: Vua làm nhà của Nơi Chí Thánh: chiều dài theo chiều rộng của nhà [là] 20 cu-đê, và chiều rộng 20 cu-đê; vua bọc nó [bằng] vàng tốt, lên đến 600 ta-lâng.
vi.B: Vua làm Nơi Chí Thánh. Chiều dài bằng chiều rộng đền thờ, là {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, và chiều rộng {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Vua bọc nơi ấy bằng vàng tốt nặng {{units:khoảng 20 tấn|600 ta-lâng}}.
vi.R: Vua làm Nơi Chí Thánh. Nơi ấy dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}, bằng chiều rộng đền thờ, và rộng {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Vua bọc nơi ấy bằng {{units:khoảng 20 tấn|600 ta-lâng}} vàng tốt.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 지극히 거룩한 곳의 집을 만들었다. 그 길이는 집의 너비를 따라 20규빗이었고, 그 너비도 20규빗이었다. 그리고 그가 그것을 좋은 금 600달란트로 입혔다.
ko.B: 그는 지성소를 만들었다. 길이는 성전의 너비와 같은 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었고, 너비도 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다. 그는 그 안을 좋은 금 {{units:20톤쯤|600달란트}}로 입혔다.
ko.R: 그는 지성소를 만들었다. 길이는 성전의 너비와 같은 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었고, 너비도 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다. 그는 그 안을 좋은 금 {{units:20톤쯤|600달란트}}로 덮었다.

decisions.choice: the house of the holy of holies: the most holy place
decisions.reason: "Holy of holies" is the Hebrew way of saying "most holy" (Exodus 26:33). This is the inner room at the back of the temple where the ark stood (1 Kings 6:16, 19), called "the inner room" in verse 16.

decisions.choice: six hundred talents: about 45,000 pounds of gold
decisions.reason: A talent was about 75 pounds, so the gold weighed some twenty-two tons. The amount matches the great wealth told of Solomon, who received 666 talents of gold in one year (1 Kings 10:14).

decisions.choice: twenty cubits by twenty: as 1 Kings 6:20
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:20 gives the same length and width, adds a height of 20 cubits, and says the room was overlaid with pure gold without giving its weight.

decisions.choice: the house of the holy of holies (Literal); the most holy place (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 26:33 and 1 Kings 6:16.

decisions.choice: about 45,000 pounds, with 600 talents as the alternative
decisions.reason: A talent is reckoned at about 75 pounds; the reader's Measures control shows the talents.

decisions.choice: "la casa del santo de los santos" (L); "el lugar santísimo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 6:16: Literal keeps the Hebrew superlative, Balanced and Readable say "el lugar santísimo".

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 20 400 kilos|seiscientos talentos}}
decisions.reason: The talent is counted at 34 kg, as the Kings terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "la maison du saint des saints" (L); "le lieu très saint" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in French Kings (1 Kings 6:16): Literal keeps the Hebrew "holy of holies"; Balanced and Readable say "le lieu très saint", the terms note's word for the inner room.

decisions.choice: nyumba ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu (Literal); Patakatifu pa Patakatifu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the room by its holiness here, so Swahili uses the name of Exodus 26:33, "Patakatifu pa Patakatifu", at every level; "chumba cha ndani" stays for the inner room (verse 16).

decisions.choice: "nhà của Nơi Chí Thánh" (L); "Nơi Chí Thánh" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's name for the most holy place; Literal keeps "house" in front of it as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 20 tấn", with "600 ta-lâng" as the alternative
decisions.reason: A talent is reckoned at 34 kg; 600 talents is about 20 tonnes.

decisions.choice: "지극히 거룩한 곳의 집" (L), "지성소" (B, R); "20톤쯤" for 600 talents
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 6:16 and the terms note; the talent at 34 kg gives 20.4 tonnes, rounded with 쯤.

source.text: וּמִשְׁקָ֛ל לְמִסְמְר֥וֹת לִשְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב וְהָעֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] weight for [the] nails, to shekels fifty, of gold; and the upper rooms he overlaid [with] gold.

en.L: And the weight for the nails [was] 50 shekels of gold; and the upper rooms he overlaid [with] gold.
en.B: The gold for the nails weighed {{units:about 1 1/4 pounds|50 shekels}}. He also overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
en.R: He used {{units:about 1 1/4 pounds|50 shekels}} of gold for the nails. He also covered the upper rooms with gold.

es.L: Y el peso de los clavos [era] de cincuenta siclos de oro; y las cámaras altas las revistió [de] oro.
es.B: El oro de los clavos pesaba {{units:unos 575 gramos|cincuenta siclos}}. También revistió de oro las habitaciones altas.
es.R: Usó {{units:unos 575 gramos|cincuenta siclos}} de oro para los clavos. También cubrió con oro las habitaciones de arriba.

fr.L: Et le poids pour les clous [était] de cinquante sicles d’or ; et les chambres hautes, il les recouvrit d’or.
fr.B: L’or des clous pesait {{units:environ 575 grammes|cinquante sicles}}. Il recouvrit aussi d’or les chambres hautes.
fr.R: Il a utilisé {{units:environ 575 grammes|cinquante sicles}} d’or pour les clous. Il a aussi couvert d’or les chambres du haut.

sw.L: Na uzito wa misumari [ulikuwa] shekeli hamsini za dhahabu; na vyumba vya juu akavifunika [kwa] dhahabu.
sw.B: Dhahabu ya misumari ilikuwa na uzito wa {{units:karibu gramu 575|shekeli hamsini}}. Akavifunika pia vyumba vya juu kwa dhahabu.
sw.R: Alitumia {{units:karibu gramu 575|shekeli hamsini}} za dhahabu kwa ajili ya misumari. Akavifunika pia vyumba vya juu kwa dhahabu.

vi.L: Trọng lượng cho các đinh [là] 50 siếc-lơ vàng; và các phòng trên lầu vua [cũng] bọc [bằng] vàng.
vi.B: Vàng dùng làm đinh nặng {{units:khoảng 575 g|50 siếc-lơ}}. Vua cũng bọc vàng các phòng trên lầu.
vi.R: Vua dùng {{units:khoảng 575 g|50 siếc-lơ}} vàng để làm đinh. Vua cũng bọc vàng các phòng trên lầu.

ko.L: 그리고 못의 무게는 금 50세겔이었다. 그리고 다락방들도 그가 금으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 못에 쓴 금은 무게가 {{units:575그램쯤|50세겔}}이었다. 그는 다락방들도 금으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 그는 못을 만드는 데 금 {{units:575그램쯤|50세겔}}을 썼다. 위층 방들도 금으로 덮었다.

decisions.choice: the weight for the nails: fifty shekels of gold
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say whether fifty shekels was the gold for all the nails or for each one. The nails may have been gold, or gold-covered nails that held the gold plating in place. 1 Kings does not mention them.

decisions.choice: the upper rooms: rooms above
decisions.reason: These were rooms on an upper level, perhaps above the most holy place, which was lower than the main building (1 Kings 6:2, 20), or upper rooms of the side building (1 Kings 6:5-6). David's plan for the temple also names them (1 Chronicles 28:11).

decisions.choice: about 1 1/4 pounds, with 50 shekels as the alternative
decisions.reason: A shekel is reckoned at about 2/5 ounce; the reader's Measures control shows the shekels.

source.text: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ בְּבֵֽית־קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים וַיְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made in [the] house of [the] holy of the holies cherubim two, a work of sculpture, and they overlaid them [with] gold.

en.L: And he made in the house of the holy of holies two cherubim, sculptured work, and they overlaid them [with] gold.
en.B: He made two cherubim of sculptured work in the most holy place, and they were overlaid with gold.
en.R: In the most holy place he made two statues of cherubim, and they were covered with gold.

es.L: E hizo en la casa del santo de los santos dos querubines, obra de escultura, y los revistieron [de] oro.
es.B: Hizo dos querubines esculpidos en el lugar santísimo, y fueron revestidos de oro.
es.R: En el lugar santísimo hizo dos estatuas de querubines, y las cubrieron con oro.

fr.L: Et il fit dans la maison du saint des saints deux chérubins, ouvrage de sculpture, et on les recouvrit d’or.
fr.B: Il fit dans le lieu très saint deux chérubins sculptés, et on les recouvrit d’or.
fr.R: Dans le lieu très saint, il a fait deux statues de chérubins, et on les a couvertes d’or.

sw.L: Akafanya katika nyumba ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu makerubi mawili, kazi ya kuchongwa, nao wakayafunika [kwa] dhahabu.
sw.B: Akafanya makerubi mawili ya kazi ya kuchongwa katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, nayo yakafunikwa kwa dhahabu.
sw.R: Katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu alitengeneza sanamu mbili za makerubi, nazo zikafunikwa kwa dhahabu.

vi.L: Trong nhà của Nơi Chí Thánh, vua làm hai chê-ru-bim, công trình điêu khắc, và người ta bọc chúng [bằng] vàng.
vi.B: Vua làm hai chê-ru-bim bằng điêu khắc trong Nơi Chí Thánh, và chúng được bọc vàng.
vi.R: Trong Nơi Chí Thánh, vua làm hai tượng chê-ru-bim, và các tượng ấy được bọc vàng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 지극히 거룩한 곳의 집에 조각한 작품으로 그룹 둘을 만들었고, 그들이 그것들을 금으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 그는 지성소에 조각한 그룹 둘을 만들었고, 그 그룹들은 금으로 입혀졌다.
ko.R: 그는 지성소에 그룹 조각상 둘을 만들었고, 그것들은 금으로 덮였다.

decisions.choice: a work of tsa'atsu'im: sculptured work
decisions.reason: The word tsa'atsu'im is found only here, and its meaning is uncertain. It is usually taken as carved or sculptured figures; others take it as cast metal work. 1 Kings 6:23 says the cherubim were made of olive wood, which fits carved figures overlaid with gold.

decisions.choice: they overlaid them: the workers overlaid them
decisions.reason: The verb is plural with no subject named; it means simply that the cherubim were overlaid with gold, as 1 Kings 6:28 says.

decisions.choice: two cherubim: 1 Kings 6:23-28
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:23 adds that each cherub was 10 cubits high; Chronicles gives only the length of their wings (verses 11-13).

decisions.choice: they were overlaid (Balanced); they were covered (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the unnamed "they" into a passive (m2); Readable says "statues" for the sculptured work.

decisions.choice: "obra de escultura"
decisions.reason: The rare word is taken as sculptured work (meaning decision); Spanish says so at Literal and folds it into "esculpidos", "estatuas" at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וְכַנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים אָרְכָּ֖ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כְּנַ֨ף הָאֶחָ֜ד לְאַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֨עַת֙ לְקִ֣יר הַבַּ֔יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] wings of the cherubim, their length [was] cubits twenty: [the] wing of the one, of cubits five, touching [the] wall of the house, and the wing the other, cubits five, touching [the] wing of the cherub the other.

en.L: And the wings of the cherubim, their length [was] 20 cubits: the wing of the one, of 5 cubits, touching the wall of the house, and the other wing, 5 cubits, touching the wing of the other cherub.
en.B: The wings of the cherubim measured {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}} in all. One wing of the first cherub, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} long, touched the wall of the temple, and its other wing, also {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}}, touched the wing of the second cherub.
en.R: Together the wings of the two cherubim reached {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}. Each wing was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} long. One wing of the first cherub touched the temple wall, and its other wing touched a wing of the second cherub.

es.L: Y las alas de los querubines, su longitud [era] de veinte codos: el ala del uno, de cinco codos, tocaba el muro de la casa, y la otra ala, de cinco codos, tocaba el ala del otro querubín.
es.B: Las alas de los querubines medían en total {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}. Un ala del primer querubín, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}}, tocaba el muro del templo, y su otra ala, también de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}}, tocaba el ala del segundo querubín.
es.R: Juntas, las alas de los dos querubines medían {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}. Cada ala medía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}}. Un ala del primer querubín tocaba la pared del templo, y su otra ala tocaba un ala del segundo querubín.

fr.L: Et les ailes des chérubins, leur longueur [était] de vingt coudées : l’aile de l’un, de cinq coudées, touchait le mur de la maison, et l’autre aile, de cinq coudées, touchait l’aile de l’autre chérubin.
fr.B: Les ailes des chérubins mesuraient en tout {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}. Une aile du premier chérubin, longue de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}}, touchait le mur du temple, et son autre aile, de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} elle aussi, touchait l’aile du second chérubin.
fr.R: Ensemble, les ailes des deux chérubins s’étendaient sur {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}. Chaque aile mesurait {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}}. Une aile du premier chérubin touchait le mur du temple, et son autre aile touchait une aile du second chérubin.

sw.L: Na mabawa ya makerubi, urefu wake [ulikuwa] dhiraa ishirini: bawa la moja, la dhiraa tano, likigusa ukuta wa nyumba, na bawa lingine, dhiraa tano, likigusa bawa la kerubi lingine.
sw.B: Mabawa ya makerubi yalikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} kwa jumla. Bawa moja la kerubi la kwanza, lenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, liligusa ukuta wa hekalu, na bawa lake lingine, nalo {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, liligusa bawa la kerubi la pili.
sw.R: Mabawa ya makerubi hayo mawili kwa pamoja yalifika {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Kila bawa lilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}. Bawa moja la kerubi la kwanza liligusa ukuta wa hekalu, na bawa lake lingine liligusa bawa la kerubi la pili.

vi.L: Các cánh của chê-ru-bim, chiều dài của chúng [là] 20 cu-đê: cánh của chê-ru-bim này, 5 cu-đê, chạm vào tường nhà, và cánh kia, 5 cu-đê, chạm vào cánh của chê-ru-bim kia.
vi.B: Các cánh của chê-ru-bim dài tổng cộng {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ nhất dài {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, chạm vào tường đền thờ, và cánh kia cũng dài {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, chạm vào cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ hai.
vi.R: Cánh của hai chê-ru-bim cộng lại dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Mỗi cánh dài {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}. Một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ nhất chạm vào tường đền thờ, còn cánh kia chạm vào một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ hai.

ko.L: 그리고 그룹들의 날개는 그 길이가 20규빗이었다. 한 [그룹의] 날개는 5규빗으로 집의 벽에 닿았고, 다른 날개도 5규빗으로 다른 그룹의 날개에 닿았다.
ko.B: 그룹들의 날개는 모두 합해 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다. 첫째 그룹의 한쪽 날개는 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}으로 성전 벽에 닿았고, 다른 쪽 날개도 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}으로 둘째 그룹의 날개에 닿았다.
ko.R: 두 그룹의 날개를 모두 합하면 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이었다. 날개 하나의 길이는 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}이었다. 첫째 그룹의 한쪽 날개는 성전 벽에 닿았고, 다른 쪽 날개는 둘째 그룹의 날개에 닿았다.

decisions.choice: their length twenty cubits: the four wings end to end
decisions.reason: Each cherub had two wings of five cubits, so the four wings together stretched twenty cubits, the full width of the most holy place (verse 8), as 1 Kings 6:24-27 also describes.

decisions.choice: the wing of the one: one wing of the first cherub
decisions.reason: "The one" is the first cherub; one of its wings touched the side wall and the other reached the second cherub's wing.

decisions.choice: in all; first ... second; Together ... two
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly which cherub is meant and that the twenty cubits are the wings together (m1, m2).

source.text: וּכְנַ֨ף הַכְּר֤וּב הָאֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְקִ֣יר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] wing of the cherub the one, cubits five, touching [the] wall of the house, and the wing the other, cubits five, joined to [the] wing of the cherub the other.

en.L: And the wing of the one cherub, 5 cubits, touching the wall of the house, and the other wing, 5 cubits, joined to the wing of the other cherub.
en.B: One wing of the second cherub, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} long, touched the other wall of the temple, and its other wing, also {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}}, met the wing of the first cherub.
en.R: In the same way, one wing of the second cherub touched the other side wall, and its other wing met a wing of the first cherub.

es.L: Y el ala del otro querubín, de cinco codos, tocaba el muro de la casa, y la otra ala, de cinco codos, se juntaba con el ala del otro querubín.
es.B: Un ala del segundo querubín, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}}, tocaba el otro muro del templo, y su otra ala, también de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}}, se juntaba con el ala del primer querubín.
es.R: Del mismo modo, un ala del segundo querubín tocaba la otra pared lateral, y su otra ala se juntaba con un ala del primer querubín.

fr.L: Et l’aile de l’un des chérubins, de cinq coudées, touchait le mur de la maison, et l’autre aile, de cinq coudées, rejoignait l’aile de l’autre chérubin.
fr.B: Une aile du second chérubin, longue de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}}, touchait l’autre mur du temple, et son autre aile, de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} elle aussi, rejoignait l’aile du premier chérubin.
fr.R: De la même façon, une aile du second chérubin touchait l’autre mur, et son autre aile rejoignait une aile du premier chérubin.

sw.L: Na bawa la kerubi moja, dhiraa tano, likigusa ukuta wa nyumba, na bawa lingine, dhiraa tano, likishikamana na bawa la kerubi lingine.
sw.B: Bawa moja la kerubi la pili, lenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, liligusa ukuta mwingine wa hekalu, na bawa lake lingine, nalo {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}, lilikutana na bawa la kerubi la kwanza.
sw.R: Vivyo hivyo, bawa moja la kerubi la pili liligusa ukuta mwingine wa pembeni, na bawa lake lingine lilikutana na bawa la kerubi la kwanza.

vi.L: Cánh của chê-ru-bim kia, 5 cu-đê, chạm vào tường nhà, và cánh còn lại, 5 cu-đê, giáp với cánh của chê-ru-bim này.
vi.B: Một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ hai dài {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, chạm vào bức tường bên kia của đền thờ, và cánh kia cũng dài {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}, giáp với cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ nhất.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ hai chạm vào bức tường bên kia, còn cánh kia giáp với một cánh của chê-ru-bim thứ nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 다른 그룹의 날개는 5규빗으로 집의 벽에 닿았고, 다른 날개도 5규빗으로 다른 그룹의 날개에 붙어 있었다.
ko.B: 둘째 그룹의 한쪽 날개도 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}으로 성전의 다른 쪽 벽에 닿았고, 다른 쪽 날개도 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}으로 첫째 그룹의 날개와 맞닿았다.
ko.R: 마찬가지로 둘째 그룹의 한쪽 날개는 반대쪽 벽에 닿았고, 다른 쪽 날개는 첫째 그룹의 날개와 맞닿았다.

decisions.choice: the one cherub ... the other cherub: here the second cherub, then the first
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not number the cherubim. In verse 11 "the one" is the first cherub; here the same words describe the second, whose inner wing meets the first cherub's wing. The other wall is the opposite side wall (1 Kings 6:27).

decisions.choice: joined to: meeting
decisions.reason: The word means "clinging" or "joined", a different word from "touching" in verse 11 but with the same sense: the inner wings met in the middle of the room.

decisions.choice: second ... first; the other wall; In the same way
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the cherubim and the wall as verse 11 and 1 Kings 6:27 make clear (m1). Readable does not repeat the five cubits given in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "el otro querubín" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the one cherub" here of the second cherub (meaning decision); Spanish Literal says "el otro" to keep the two apart, and Balanced and Readable number them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "둘째 그룹", "첫째 그룹" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not number the cherubim (m1); Balanced and Readable say which is which, as the English does.

source.text: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְהֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל־רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם לַבָּֽיִת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] wings of the cherubim these [were] spreading out cubits twenty; and they [were] standing on their feet, and their faces toward the house.

en.L: The wings of these cherubim spread out 20 cubits; and they stood on their feet, and their faces [were] toward the house.
en.B: The wings of these cherubim spread out {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}. They stood on their feet, facing the main hall.
en.R: The wings of these cherubim spread out {{units:about 30 feet|20 cubits}}. The cherubim stood on their feet and faced out toward the main room.

es.L: Las alas de estos querubines se extendían veinte codos; y ellos estaban de pie sobre sus pies, y sus rostros [miraban] hacia la casa.
es.B: Las alas de estos querubines se extendían {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}. Estaban de pie, mirando hacia la sala principal.
es.R: Las alas de estos querubines se extendían {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}}. Los querubines estaban de pie y miraban hacia la sala principal.

fr.L: Les ailes de ces chérubins se déployaient sur vingt coudées ; et ils se tenaient debout sur leurs pieds, et leurs faces [étaient tournées] vers la maison.
fr.B: Les ailes de ces chérubins se déployaient sur {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}. Ils se tenaient debout sur leurs pieds, tournés vers la grande salle.
fr.R: Les ailes de ces chérubins s’étendaient sur {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}. Les chérubins se tenaient debout et regardaient vers la salle principale.

sw.L: Mabawa ya makerubi haya yalienea dhiraa ishirini; nayo yalisimama kwa miguu yake, na nyuso zake [zilielekea] nyumba.
sw.B: Mabawa ya makerubi haya yalienea {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Yalisimama kwa miguu yake, yakielekea ukumbi mkuu.
sw.R: Mabawa ya makerubi haya yalienea {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}. Makerubi hayo yalisimama kwa miguu yake, na nyuso zake zilielekea chumba kikuu.

vi.L: Cánh của các chê-ru-bim này xòe ra 20 cu-đê; chúng đứng trên chân mình, và mặt chúng [hướng] về phía nhà.
vi.B: Cánh của các chê-ru-bim này xòe ra {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Chúng đứng thẳng trên chân, mặt hướng về chính điện.
vi.R: Cánh của các chê-ru-bim này xòe ra dài {{units:9 m|20 cu-đê}}. Các chê-ru-bim đứng trên chân và quay mặt ra phía gian chính.

ko.L: 이 그룹들의 날개는 20규빗으로 펼쳐져 있었다. 그리고 그것들은 자기 발로 서 있었고, 그 얼굴은 집을 향해 [있었다].
ko.B: 이 그룹들의 날개는 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}으로 펼쳐져 있었다. 그룹들은 발로 서서 본당을 바라보고 있었다.
ko.R: 이 그룹들은 날개를 {{units:9미터쯤|20규빗}}이나 펼치고 있었다. 그룹들은 발로 서서 바깥쪽 큰 방을 바라보고 있었다.

decisions.choice: standing on their feet: standing upright on the floor
decisions.reason: Unlike the two small cherubim of the tabernacle, which were part of the ark's cover (Exodus 25:18-20), these large figures stood on the floor of the room, with the ark beneath their wings (5:7-8).

decisions.choice: their faces toward the house: facing out toward the main hall
decisions.reason: "The house" here is the main part of the building in front of the most holy place (verse 5). The cherubim faced out toward the entrance, not toward each other as the cherubim on the ark did (Exodus 25:20).

decisions.choice: facing the main hall (Balanced); faced out toward the main room (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the room meant by "the house" (m2).

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּב֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖יו כְּרוּבִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made the veil [of] violet and purple and crimson and fine linen, and he put up on it cherubim.

en.L: And he made the veil of blue and purple and crimson [yarn] and fine linen, and he worked cherubim on it.
en.B: He made the inner curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, and worked cherubim into its design.
en.R: He made the inner curtain from blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, and he had cherubim woven into it.

es.L: E hizo el velo de azul y púrpura y carmesí [en lana] y lino fino, e hizo poner querubines sobre él.
es.B: Hizo la cortina interior de lana azul, púrpura y carmesí, y de lino fino, y bordó en ella querubines.
es.R: Hizo la cortina interior con lana azul, púrpura y carmesí, y con lino fino, y mandó tejer en ella figuras de querubines.

fr.L: Et il fit le voile [de fil] bleu, et pourpre, et cramoisi, et de fin lin, et il y mit des chérubins.
fr.B: Il fit le rideau intérieur de fil bleu, pourpre et cramoisi et de fin lin, et il y fit tisser des chérubins.
fr.R: Il a fait le rideau intérieur avec du fil bleu, pourpre et cramoisi et du fin lin, et il y a fait tisser des chérubins.

sw.L: Akafanya pazia la [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu na kitani safi, akatia makerubi juu yake.
sw.B: Akafanya pazia la ndani kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi, akafuma makerubi katika mchoro wake.
sw.R: Akafanya pazia la ndani kwa uzi wa samawati, zambarau na nyekundu, na kitani safi, naye akaagiza makerubi yafumwe ndani yake.

vi.L: Vua làm bức màn [bằng chỉ] xanh dương, tía và đỏ thẫm và vải gai mịn, và thêu các chê-ru-bim trên đó.
vi.B: Vua làm bức màn bên trong bằng chỉ xanh dương, tía, đỏ thẫm và vải gai mịn, rồi thêu hình các chê-ru-bim trên màn.
vi.R: Vua làm bức màn bên trong bằng chỉ xanh dương, tía, đỏ thẫm và vải gai mịn, và cho dệt hình các chê-ru-bim trên màn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 청색 실과 자주색 실과 진홍색 실과 고운 베로 휘장을 만들고, 그 위에 그룹들을 수놓아 올렸다.
ko.B: 그는 청색과 자주색과 진홍색 실과 고운 베로 지성소 휘장을 만들고, 거기에 그룹들을 수놓았다.
ko.R: 그는 파란색과 자주색과 붉은색 실과 고운 베로 지성소 앞에 칠 휘장을 만들었다. 그리고 거기에 그룹들을 수놓았다.

decisions.choice: the veil: the curtain before the most holy place
decisions.reason: This word is used of the curtain that shut off the most holy place in the tabernacle (Exodus 26:31-33), made of the same colors with cherubim worked into it.

decisions.choice: the veil: 1 Kings speaks of doors
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 6:31-32 describes doors of olive wood at the entrance of the inner room, and does not mention a veil. Chronicles names a veil like the tabernacle's, and later also mentions doors of the inner house (4:22). There may have been both: the gold chains drawn across the front of the inner room (1 Kings 6:21) may have held a curtain.

decisions.choice: crimson; fine linen: later words for the tabernacle's scarlet and linen
decisions.reason: The word for crimson is found only in Chronicles (2:6, 13), and the word for fine linen is a later word than the one in Exodus. They name the same costly dyed yarn and linen.

decisions.choice: put up on it cherubim: worked cherubim into it
decisions.reason: The verb "made go up" is the one used in verse 5: the figures were set into the fabric, as on the tabernacle veil, which was "the work of a skilled craftsman" (Exodus 26:31).

decisions.choice: the veil (Literal); the inner curtain (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 26:31.

decisions.choice: [yarn] (Literal); yarn (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the colors only; English needs the noun, as in Exodus 26:31.

decisions.choice: "el velo" (L); "la cortina interior" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the curtain before the most holy place; Balanced and Readable use the Spanish Exodus word "la cortina interior".

decisions.choice: "le voile" (L); "le rideau intérieur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words of the French Pentateuch for the curtain before the most holy place (Exodus 26:31), as the English follows Exodus.

decisions.choice: pazia (Literal); pazia la ndani (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Swahili Exodus 26:31 names the veil before the most holy place.

decisions.choice: "bức màn" (L); "bức màn bên trong" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The curtain before the most holy place (m1); Balanced and Readable say it was the inner one, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "휘장" (L), "지성소 휘장" (B), "지성소 앞에 칠 휘장" (R)
decisions.reason: The curtain before the most holy place (m1); Balanced and Readable say which curtain, as the English "inner curtain".

source.text: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לִפְנֵ֤י הַבַּ֨יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ וְהַצֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר־עַל־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made before the house pillars two, cubits thirty and five [in] length; and the capital which [was] on its top, cubits five.

en.L: And he made in front of the house two pillars, 35 cubits [in] length; and the capital that [was] on its top [was] 5 cubits.
en.B: In front of the temple he made two pillars {{units:about 52 feet|35 cubits}} long, each with a capital {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high on top.
en.R: He made two pillars to stand in front of the temple. They measured {{units:about 52 feet|35 cubits}}. On top of each one was a capital, a decorated top piece {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} high.

es.L: E hizo delante de la casa dos columnas de treinta y cinco codos de longitud; y el capitel que [estaba] sobre la cabeza de cada una, de cinco codos.
es.B: Delante del templo hizo dos columnas de {{units:unos 15,75 metros|treinta y cinco codos}} de largo, cada una con un capitel de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto encima.
es.R: Hizo dos columnas para ponerlas delante del templo. Medían {{units:unos 15,75 metros|treinta y cinco codos}}. Encima de cada una había un capitel, una pieza adornada de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto.

fr.L: Et il fit devant la maison deux colonnes, de trente-cinq coudées de longueur ; et le chapiteau qui [était] sur leur sommet [avait] cinq coudées.
fr.B: Devant le temple, il fit deux colonnes longues de {{units:environ 15,75 mètres|trente-cinq coudées}}, avec à leur sommet un chapiteau de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}}.
fr.R: Il a fait deux colonnes pour les placer devant le temple. Elles mesuraient {{units:environ 15,75 mètres|trente-cinq coudées}}. En haut de chacune, il y avait un chapiteau, une pièce décorée de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut.

sw.L: Akafanya mbele ya nyumba nguzo mbili, dhiraa thelathini na tano urefu; na kichwa kilichokuwa juu yake dhiraa tano.
sw.B: Mbele ya hekalu akafanya nguzo mbili zenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 15.75|dhiraa thelathini na tano}}, kila moja ikiwa na kichwa cha kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}} juu yake.
sw.R: Alitengeneza nguzo mbili za kusimama mbele ya hekalu. Urefu wake ulikuwa {{units:karibu mita 15.75|dhiraa thelathini na tano}}. Juu ya kila moja kulikuwa na kichwa, yaani, sehemu ya juu iliyopambwa, chenye kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}}.

vi.L: Vua làm trước nhà hai trụ, [dài] 35 cu-đê; và đầu trụ ở trên đỉnh mỗi trụ [là] 5 cu-đê.
vi.B: Phía trước đền thờ vua làm hai trụ dài {{units:15,75 m|35 cu-đê}}, trên đỉnh mỗi trụ có một đầu trụ cao {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Vua làm hai trụ dựng phía trước đền thờ. Các trụ ấy đo được {{units:15,75 m|35 cu-đê}}. Trên đỉnh mỗi trụ có một đầu trụ, tức là phần đỉnh được trang trí, cao {{units:2,25 m|5 cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 집 앞에 기둥 둘을 만들었는데, 길이가 35규빗이었다. 그리고 그 꼭대기에 있는 기둥머리는 5규빗이었다.
ko.B: 그는 성전 앞에 기둥 둘을 만들었는데, 길이가 {{units:16미터쯤|35규빗}}이었고, 기둥마다 꼭대기에 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}} 높이의 기둥머리가 있었다.
ko.R: 그는 성전 앞에 세울 기둥 둘을 만들었다. 기둥의 길이는 {{units:16미터쯤|35규빗}}이었다. 기둥마다 꼭대기에는 장식이 달린 머리 부분인 기둥머리가 있었는데, 높이가 {{units:2.25미터쯤|5규빗}}이었다.

decisions.choice: thirty-five cubits: 1 Kings 7:15 has eighteen
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:15, 2 Kings 25:17 and Jeremiah 52:21 give each pillar a height of eighteen cubits. Here the word is "length", not height, and the number may be the two pillars together (eighteen and eighteen, near thirty-five), the length of the bronze as it was cast, or a difference that arose in copying, since numbers could be written with letters that are easily confused. The reason for the difference is not known.

decisions.choice: the capital: the crowning piece on top of each pillar
decisions.reason: The word for capital here is found only in this verse; 1 Kings 7:16 uses another word. Both name the large decorated top of each pillar, five cubits high in both books. "Its top" means the top of each pillar.

decisions.choice: long (Balanced); measured (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "length", not "height", so Balanced and Readable do not say how the pillars were measured (m1).

decisions.choice: a decorated top piece
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:16, Readable explains the building word "capital".

decisions.choice: "dài" (B), "đo được" (R), not "cao"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "length", not "height" (m1), so Vietnamese does not say how the pillars were measured, as the English.

source.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּדְּבִ֔יר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמֻּדִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים֙ מֵאָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן בַּֽשַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made chains in the inner room, and he put [them] on [the] top of the pillars; and he made pomegranates one hundred, and he put [them] on the chains.

en.L: And he made chains in the inner room and put [them] on the top of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates and put [them] on the chains.
en.B: He made chains in the inner sanctuary and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains.
en.R: He made chains in the inner room and put them on the tops of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and hung them on the chains.

es.L: E hizo cadenas en el cuarto interior y [las] puso sobre la cabeza de las columnas; e hizo cien granadas y [las] puso en las cadenas.
es.B: Hizo cadenas en el santuario interior y las puso encima de las columnas. Hizo también cien granadas y las puso en las cadenas.
es.R: Hizo cadenas en el cuarto interior y las puso en la parte de arriba de las columnas. También hizo cien granadas y las colgó de las cadenas.

fr.L: Et il fit des chaînettes dans le lieu très saint et [les] mit sur le sommet des colonnes ; et il fit cent grenades et [les] mit aux chaînettes.
fr.B: Il fit des chaînettes dans le lieu très saint et les mit au sommet des colonnes. Il fit aussi cent grenades, qu’il mit aux chaînettes.
fr.R: Il a fait des chaînettes dans le lieu très saint et il les a mises en haut des colonnes. Il a aussi fait cent grenades et il les a accrochées aux chaînettes.

sw.L: Akafanya minyororo katika chumba cha ndani, akaitia juu ya vichwa vya nguzo; akafanya makomamanga 100, akayatia juu ya minyororo.
sw.B: Akafanya minyororo katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, akaiweka juu ya nguzo. Akafanya pia makomamanga 100, akayaweka juu ya minyororo.
sw.R: Akafanya minyororo katika chumba cha ndani, akaiweka juu ya vichwa vya nguzo. Akafanya pia makomamanga 100, akayatundika kwenye minyororo.

vi.L: Vua làm những dây xích trong phòng trong, và đặt [chúng] trên đỉnh các trụ; vua làm một trăm trái lựu và đặt [chúng] trên các dây xích.
vi.B: Vua làm những dây xích trong phòng trong rồi đặt trên đỉnh các trụ. Vua cũng làm một trăm trái lựu và gắn vào các dây xích.
vi.R: Vua làm những dây xích trong phòng trong và đặt trên đỉnh các trụ. Vua cũng làm một trăm trái lựu và treo vào các dây xích.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 내실에 사슬을 만들어 기둥들 꼭대기에 두었다. 그리고 석류 백 개를 만들어 사슬에 달았다.
ko.B: 그는 지성소에서 사슬을 만들어 기둥 꼭대기에 두르고, 석류 백 개를 만들어 그 사슬에 달았다.
ko.R: 그는 내실에 사슬을 만들어 기둥 꼭대기에 둘렀다. 그리고 석류 백 개를 만들어 그 사슬에 달았다.

decisions.choice: chains in the inner room: as the Hebrew text reads
decisions.reason: The pillars stood outside, in front of the temple, so chains "in the inner room" are puzzling. A change of one letter gives "like a necklace", describing chains set around the tops of the pillars like a necklace. The phrase may also mean chains like those in the inner room (1 Kings 6:21). The Hebrew is kept.

decisions.choice: a hundred pomegranates: 1 Kings 7:20 and 7:42
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:18-20 describes wreaths of chain work and two rows of pomegranates on each capital, two hundred on each, four hundred in all (1 Kings 7:42). Jeremiah 52:23 speaks of a hundred on the network all around. The hundred here may be a row or the count on one pillar.

decisions.choice: pomegranates: bronze fruit as ornaments
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:18, pomegranates were a sign of the land's fruitfulness (Deuteronomy 8:8).

decisions.choice: the inner room (Literal, Readable); the inner sanctuary (Balanced)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 6:16 and 6:19.

decisions.choice: "el cuarto interior" (L, R); "el santuario interior" (B)
decisions.reason: The devir follows the Kings terms note at Literal and Balanced; at Readable the English keeps "inner room", since the text puzzles here (meaning decision), so Spanish keeps "el cuarto interior" rather than "el lugar santísimo".

decisions.choice: "le lieu très saint" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "le lieu très saint" for the inner room (*devir*) at every level, as French Kings has it; the English says "inner room" and "inner sanctuary". The puzzle of chains there is the meaning decision's (m1).

decisions.choice: chumba cha ndani (Literal, Readable); Patakatifu pa Patakatifu (Balanced)
decisions.reason: As the Swahili 1 Kings 6 renders the *devir*: "chumba cha ndani" at Literal and Readable, its name at Balanced, as the English uses "inner sanctuary".

decisions.choice: "내실" (L, R), "지성소" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "in the inner room" (m1), a puzzling place for chains on outside pillars; Korean keeps the reading, as the English does, with the Balanced word of the terms note.

records.literal_gloss: And he set up the pillars on [the] face of the temple, one from [the] right and one from the left; and he called [the] name of the right [one] Jachin, and [the] name of the left [one] Boaz.

en.L: And he set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right and one on the left; and he called the name of the right [one] Jachin and the name of the left [one] Boaz.
en.B: He erected the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right and the other on the left. The pillar on the right he named Jachin, and the pillar on the left he named Boaz.
en.R: He put up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right side and one on the left. He named the pillar on the right Jachin, which means "He establishes", and he named the pillar on the left Boaz, which may mean "In him is strength".

es.L: Y levantó las columnas delante del templo, una a la derecha y otra a la izquierda; y llamó el nombre de la derecha Jaquín, y el nombre de la izquierda Boaz.
es.B: Levantó las columnas delante del templo, una a la derecha y la otra a la izquierda. A la columna de la derecha la llamó Jaquín, y a la de la izquierda la llamó Boaz.
es.R: Colocó las columnas delante del templo, una a la derecha y otra a la izquierda. A la columna de la derecha la llamó Jaquín, que significa “Él establece”, y a la de la izquierda la llamó Boaz, que quizá significa “En él está la fuerza”.

fr.L: Et il dressa les colonnes devant le temple, l’une à droite et l’autre à gauche ; et il appela du nom de Yakîn celle de droite, et du nom de Boaz celle de gauche.
fr.B: Il érigea les colonnes devant le temple, l’une à droite et l’autre à gauche. Il nomma Yakîn la colonne de droite, et Boaz la colonne de gauche.
fr.R: Il a dressé les colonnes devant le temple, une du côté droit et une du côté gauche. Il a appelé la colonne de droite Yakîn, ce qui veut dire « Il établit », et il a appelé la colonne de gauche Boaz, ce qui veut peut-être dire « En lui est la force ».

sw.L: Akazisimamisha nguzo mbele ya hekalu, moja upande wa kuume na moja upande wa kushoto; akaliita jina la [ile ya] kuume Yakini, na jina la [ile ya] kushoto Boazi.
sw.B: Alizisimamisha nguzo mbele ya hekalu, moja upande wa kuume na nyingine upande wa kushoto. Nguzo ya upande wa kuume akaiita Yakini, na nguzo ya upande wa kushoto akaiita Boazi.
sw.R: Alizisimamisha nguzo mbele ya hekalu, moja upande wa kuume na moja upande wa kushoto. Nguzo ya upande wa kuume akaiita Yakini, maana yake "Yeye huimarisha", na nguzo ya upande wa kushoto akaiita Boazi, ambalo huenda maana yake ni "Ndani yake mna nguvu".

vi.L: Vua dựng các trụ ở phía trước đền thờ, một bên phải và một bên trái; vua gọi tên [trụ] bên phải là Gia-kin, và tên [trụ] bên trái là Bô-ô.
vi.B: Vua dựng các trụ phía trước đền thờ, một trụ bên phải và một trụ bên trái. Trụ bên phải vua đặt tên là Gia-kin, còn trụ bên trái vua đặt tên là Bô-ô.
vi.R: Vua dựng các trụ phía trước đền thờ, một trụ bên phải và một trụ bên trái. Vua đặt tên trụ bên phải là Gia-kin, nghĩa là "Ngài lập vững", và đặt tên trụ bên trái là Bô-ô, có lẽ nghĩa là "Trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có sức mạnh".

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 기둥들을 성전 앞에 세웠는데, 하나는 오른쪽에, 하나는 왼쪽에 [세웠다]. 그리고 오른쪽 것의 이름을 야긴이라 하고, 왼쪽 것의 이름을 보아스라 했다.
ko.B: 그는 기둥들을 성전 앞에 하나는 오른쪽에, 하나는 왼쪽에 세웠다. 오른쪽 기둥은 야긴이라 하고, 왼쪽 기둥은 보아스라고 했다.
ko.R: 그는 기둥들을 성전 앞 오른쪽과 왼쪽에 하나씩 세웠다. 오른쪽 기둥은 '그분께서 세우신다'라는 뜻으로 야긴이라고 했다. 왼쪽 기둥은 '그분 안에 힘이 있다'라는 뜻인 듯한 보아스라고 했다.

decisions.choice: Jachin: "he establishes" or "he will establish"
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:21. The name is a verb form meaning "he makes firm"; the one who establishes is probably Yahweh, who promised to establish David's house and throne (1 Chronicles 17:11-14).

decisions.choice: Boaz: probably "in him is strength"
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:21. The meaning of this name is less clear; it is usually explained as "in him (or it) is strength". Boaz is also the name of David's ancestor (Ruth 4:21-22).

decisions.choice: in front of the temple: 1 Kings 7:21 has "at the porch of the temple"
decisions.reason: Both books name the pillars the same way and place Jachin on the right and Boaz on the left. 1 Kings 7:21 sets them at the porch; Chronicles says in front of the temple. The word for temple here names the main hall, before which the porch stood (1 Kings 6:3).

decisions.choice: the right one: the written and read forms differ in spelling
decisions.reason: The written text and the form read aloud differ slightly in the spelling of "the right one"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: which means "He establishes"; which may mean "In him is strength"
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:21, Readable gives the likely meanings of the names; the second is marked "may" because its sense is less certain (m2).

decisions.choice: erected (Balanced); set up (Literal); put up (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:21.
